data.name: ReadTransaction
data.value: SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY; SET LOCAL statement_timeout='2000ms';

data.name: PersonalPage
data.value: WITH current_heads AS ( SELECT h.effect_id,h.company_id,h.news_material_id,h.literal_object_ref,r.payload_json::jsonb AS revision FROM questions h JOIN question_revisions r ON r.revision_id=h.current_revision_id WHERE h.company_id=@company UNION ALL SELECT h.effect_id,h.company_id,h.news_material_id,h.literal_object_ref,r.payload_json::jsonb AS revision FROM effects h JOIN effect_revisions r ON r.revision_id=h.current_revision_id WHERE h.company_id=@company ), scoped AS ( SELECT h.*,insight_utc_ticks(h.revision->>'createdAt') AS order_ticks, COALESCE(NULLIF(h.revision->>'newsMaterialId',''),h.news_material_id) AS current_news, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM question_validity_events e WHERE e.effect_id=h.effect_id AND e.known_ticks<=@now AND e.kind='invalidated' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM question_validity_events n WHERE n.effect_id=e.effect_id AND n.material_id=e.material_id AND n.known_ticks<=@now AND (n.known_ticks>e.known_ticks OR (n.known_ticks=e.known_ticks AND n.event_id>e.event_id)))) AS stale FROM current_heads h ) SELECT effect_id AS "Id",company_id::uuid AS "CompanyId",current_news AS "NewsMaterialId",literal_object_ref AS "LiteralObjectRef", revision::text AS "RevisionJson",order_ticks AS "OrderTicks",stale AS "RequiresReassessment" FROM scoped WHERE (CAST(@status AS text) IS NULL OR revision->>'status'=CAST(@status AS text)) AND (CAST(@mechanism AS text) IS NULL OR revision#>>'{question,mechanism}'=CAST(@mechanism AS text)) AND (CAST(@news AS text) IS NULL OR current_news=CAST(@news AS text)) AND (CAST(@importance AS integer) IS NULL OR (revision#>>'{companyImportance,score}')::integer>=CAST(@importance AS integer)) AND (CAST(@after AS bigint) IS NULL OR (order_ticks,effect_id COLLATE "C")<(CAST(@after AS bigint),CAST(@id AS text) COLLATE "C")) ORDER BY order_ticks DESC,effect_id COLLATE "C" DESC LIMIT @take

data.name: PersonalDetail
data.value: WITH current_heads AS ( SELECT h.effect_id,h.company_id,h.news_material_id,h.literal_object_ref,r.payload_json::jsonb AS revision FROM questions h JOIN question_revisions r ON r.revision_id=h.current_revision_id WHERE h.company_id=@company UNION ALL SELECT h.effect_id,h.company_id,h.news_material_id,h.literal_object_ref,r.payload_json::jsonb AS revision FROM effects h JOIN effect_revisions r ON r.revision_id=h.current_revision_id WHERE h.company_id=@company ), scoped AS ( SELECT h.*,insight_utc_ticks(h.revision->>'createdAt') AS order_ticks, COALESCE(NULLIF(h.revision->>'newsMaterialId',''),h.news_material_id) AS current_news, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM question_validity_events e WHERE e.effect_id=h.effect_id AND e.known_ticks<=@now AND e.kind='invalidated' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM question_validity_events n WHERE n.effect_id=e.effect_id AND n.material_id=e.material_id AND n.known_ticks<=@now AND (n.known_ticks>e.known_ticks OR (n.known_ticks=e.known_ticks AND n.event_id>e.event_id)))) AS stale FROM current_heads h ) SELECT effect_id AS "Id",company_id::uuid AS "CompanyId",current_news AS "NewsMaterialId",literal_object_ref AS "LiteralObjectRef", revision::text AS "RevisionJson",order_ticks AS "OrderTicks",stale AS "RequiresReassessment" FROM scoped WHERE effect_id=@id LIMIT 1

data.name: PersonalHistory
data.value: WITH history AS ( SELECT r.sequence,r.payload_json FROM question_revisions r JOIN questions h ON h.effect_id=r.effect_id WHERE h.company_id=@company AND h.effect_id=@id UNION ALL SELECT r.sequence,r.payload_json FROM effect_revisions r JOIN effects h ON h.effect_id=r.effect_id WHERE h.company_id=@company AND h.effect_id=@id ) SELECT sequence AS "Sequence",payload_json AS "RevisionJson" FROM history WHERE CAST(@after AS bigint) IS NULL OR sequence<CAST(@after AS bigint) ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT @take

data.name: GeneralPage
data.value: WITH eligible AS ( SELECT job_id,updated_ticks,payload::jsonb AS document FROM news_jobs WHERE status IN ('completed','partial') AND COALESCE(payload::jsonb#>'{checkpoint,selectedCompanyIds}','[]'::jsonb) @> jsonb_build_array(CAST(@company AS text)) AND jsonb_typeof(payload::jsonb#>'{checkpoint,result,generalInsights}')='array' ), latest AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (document#>>'{request,newsMaterialId}',document#>>'{request,newsVersionId}') * FROM eligible ORDER BY document#>>'{request,newsMaterialId}',document#>>'{request,newsVersionId}',updated_ticks DESC,job_id COLLATE "C" DESC ), expanded AS ( SELECT j.*,g.value AS insight,(g.ordinality-1)::integer AS insight_index FROM latest j CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(j.document#>'{checkpoint,result,generalInsights}') WITH ORDINALITY g(value,ordinality) ) SELECT job_id AS "JobId",insight_index AS "InsightIndex",updated_ticks AS "OrderTicks", document#>>'{request,newsMaterialId}' AS "NewsMaterialId",document#>>'{request,newsVersionId}' AS "NewsVersionId", document#>>'{request,asOf}' AS "AsOf",document->>'updatedAt' AS "UpdatedAt", COALESCE(document#>>'{request,parameters,textCompleteness}','unknown') AS "TextCompleteness", COALESCE((SELECT c->>'status' FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(document#>'{checkpoint,companies}','[]'::jsonb)) c WHERE c->>'companyId'=@company LIMIT 1),'pending') AS "CompanyStatus", insight::text AS "InsightJson" FROM expanded WHERE (CAST(@news AS text) IS NULL OR document#>>'{request,newsMaterialId}'=CAST(@news AS text)) AND (CAST(@after AS bigint) IS NULL OR (updated_ticks,job_id COLLATE "C",insight_index)<(CAST(@after AS bigint),CAST(@id AS text) COLLATE "C",CAST(@index AS integer))) ORDER BY updated_ticks DESC,job_id COLLATE "C" DESC,insight_index DESC LIMIT @take

data.name: GeneralDetail
data.value: WITH eligible AS ( SELECT job_id,updated_ticks,payload::jsonb AS document FROM news_jobs WHERE status IN ('completed','partial') AND COALESCE(payload::jsonb#>'{checkpoint,selectedCompanyIds}','[]'::jsonb) @> jsonb_build_array(CAST(@company AS text)) AND jsonb_typeof(payload::jsonb#>'{checkpoint,result,generalInsights}')='array' ), expanded AS ( SELECT j.*,g.value AS insight,(g.ordinality-1)::integer AS insight_index FROM eligible j CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(j.document#>'{checkpoint,result,generalInsights}') WITH ORDINALITY g(value,ordinality) ) SELECT job_id AS "JobId",insight_index AS "InsightIndex",updated_ticks AS "OrderTicks", document#>>'{request,newsMaterialId}' AS "NewsMaterialId",document#>>'{request,newsVersionId}' AS "NewsVersionId", document#>>'{request,asOf}' AS "AsOf",document->>'updatedAt' AS "UpdatedAt", COALESCE(document#>>'{request,parameters,textCompleteness}','unknown') AS "TextCompleteness", COALESCE((SELECT c->>'status' FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(document#>'{checkpoint,companies}','[]'::jsonb)) c WHERE c->>'companyId'=@company LIMIT 1),'pending') AS "CompanyStatus", insight::text AS "InsightJson" FROM expanded WHERE job_id=@id AND insight_index=@index LIMIT 1
